map.维保周期和年检周期有什么区别？: What is the difference between maintenance and annual inspection cycles?
map.维保是日常半月保或月保（15 天或 30 天一次），年检是特种设备定期检验（通常: Maintenance is routine fortnightly or monthly servicing (every 15 or 30 days), while the annual inspection is the statutory periodic test for special equipment (usually once a year). Both need reminders before due and neither substitutes for the other.
map.逾期未检会有什么后果？: What are the consequences of an overdue inspection?
map.电梯超期未检属违规运行，监管部门可责令停用并处罚款；台账里的逾期标记用于倒逼及时: Operating a lift past its inspection due date is a regulatory violation; authorities may order it out of service and impose fines. The overdue flag in the ledger pressures timely scheduling to avoid running a defective unit.

map.某梯检验报告有效期至 2026-06-01（示例按 1 年出具）→ 按报告有效期: A lift has a periodic inspection report valid until 2026-06-01 (example issued for one year) → manage by the report expiry date; when less than 30 days remain, prepare the self-inspection report and application materials. Do not derive a fixed one-year cycle from the installation date.
map.维保是日常半月保或月保（15 天或 30 天一次）；定期检验以检验报告载明的有效: Maintenance is routine fortnightly or monthly servicing (every 15 or 30 days); periodic inspection follows the expiry date stated in the inspection report and must not be defaulted to a fixed one-year cycle. Both need reminders before their own due dates and cannot replace each other.
